title: CSE Engineer
description:
Not just a job, but a career Yokogawa, award winner for Best Asset Monitoring Technology and Best Digital Twin Technology at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries. Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect. About the Team 
 Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do. RESPONSIBILITIES Product/Service Information Provide advanced product/service information and respond to basic customer questions about the product/service. Customer Order Processing Record and process custom/special customer orders, often dealing with ambiguous delivery expectations. Resolving Customer Issues Respond to basic issue escalations promptly and appropriately; provide managerial approvals as required. Customer Relationship Development / Prospecting Make calls (by telephone or in person) to allocated customers to develop new relationships. Act as a first point of contact for resolving customer queries and complaints. Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data Schedule follow-up actions and enter relevant information into the customer relationship management system after each contact with a customer to create a call plan and to ensure that the organization has quality data to enable effective customer retention and business development activities. Customer Needs Clarification Interview the customer, following a complex multi-level sales script, to clarify the customers requirements. Or assist in conducting interviews with potential customers to collect client requirements making detailed notes. Renewals Provide exceptional service to customers to encourage continued use of the organizations products/services. Operational Compliance Develop knowledge and understanding of the organizations policies and procedures and of relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct to ensure own work adheres to those standards. Obtain authorization from a supervisor or manager for any exceptions from mandatory procedure. Personal Capability Building Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching. Develop and maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media. Behavioral Competencies Customer Focus Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions. For example, keeps in contact with customers to ensure problems are resolved, or to improve customer service. Studies customer feedback and emerging customer needs and uses these to determine some creative new ideas. Manages Complexity Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. For example, quickly determines the most critical data and focuses analysis there; recognizes even subtle symptoms that indicate problems; probes deeply for root causes; uses systematic problem-solving methods. well. Skills Customer-Focused Approach Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to orient the sellers organization around delivering to the key needs of their customers. Leverages Digital Communications with Customers Works at an intermediate level to leverage digital communication (email, text, chat, social media) to create positive, defining moments for customers. Typically works with guidance. Masters Service Conversations Works at an intermediate level to navigate customer conversations by leveraging the four parts of a service conversation: open, learn, reply, and close. Typically works with guidance. Navigates Customer Challenges Works at an intermediate level to navigate conversations in which the customer is frustrated or unhappy with the organization. Typically works with guidance. Strengthens Customer Connections Works at an intermediate level to connect with customers to strengthen the relationship, meeting personal needs through positive customer experiences. Typically works with guidance. Builds Customer Loyalty Works at an intermediate level to make every customer interaction positive by leaving the customer feeling understood, appreciated, and confident in the organizations ability. Typically works with guidance. In-Depth Questioning Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to explore the depth and breadth of a problem, draw out the implications of not changing, and help clients self-discover and articulate the value of a solution. Initiates Compelling Sales Conversations Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to propose a mutually agreed-upon agenda to start sales conversations that offer value to the client. Service Into Sales Works at an intermediate level to recognize sales opportunities during service interactions to enhance overall customer service. Typically works with guidance. Builds Rapport Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to quickly and effectively establish trust within the buying centers in the client s organization. Knows the Buying Influences Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to accurately identify and understand the key buying influences pertaining to an opportunity. Manages Buyer Indifference Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to acknowledge and ask questions to understand the circumstances surrounding client indifference. Understands Issues/Motivations Works with guidance (but not constant supervision) to articulate why a client does or does not want a change based on their business objectives and challenges. Education Post-Secondary Non-Tertiary Education General Experience Sound experience and understanding of straightforward procedures or systems (7 to 12 months) Managerial Experience Very limited (0 to 3 months) Yokogawa is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Yokogawa wants a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture. We will actively recruit, develop, and promote people from a variety of backgrounds who differ in terms of experience, knowledge, thinking styles, perspective, cultural background, and socioeconomic status. We will not discriminate based on race, skin color, age, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, belief, political opinion, nationality, ethnicity, place of origin, disability, family relations or any other circumstances. Yokogawa values differences and enables everyone to belong, contribute, succeed, and demonstrate their full potential. Establish the go-to-market strategy with clear industry-specific positioning, competitive differentiation, and win themes.   IP, Asset & Solution Building - Own the creation of differentiated intellectual property (IP), reusable assets, solution accelerators, and frameworks that give Visionet a unique market edge. - Build industry-specific transformation playbooks, process blueprints, maturity assessment tools, and automation-readiness frameworks. - Develop proprietary methodologies for AI-driven process transformation - from process mining and discovery to Agentic process redesign and deployment. - Create ready-to-deploy solution templates and reference architectures for common transformation patterns across focus industries. - Develop compelling go-to-market collaterals: case studies, point-of-view documents, whitepapers, offering decks, and thought leadership content. - Ensure all IP and assets are continuously evolved based on market feedback, delivery learnings, and emerging technology capabilities.   Business Development & Client Engagement - Build and own the new business pipeline to meet the groeth charter - identify, qualify, and convert opportunities across focus industries. - Lead customer conversations, discovery workshops, process maturity assessments, and strategy sessions at CXO and VP level. - Manage the end-to-end deal lifecycle: opportunity identification, solution design, proposal development, pricing, negotiation, and closure. - Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders on the client side - deeply understand their pain points, regulatory landscape, operational challenges, and transformation readiness. - Own stakeholder management across client organizations spanning business, operations, technology, and compliance functions.   Cross-Functional Collaboration within Visionet Ecosystem - Work closely with the AI/ML team to infuse Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation into every transformation solution. - Collaborate with the Product team to align platform capabilities with process transformation needs and co-create product-led solutions. - Partner with Industry SMEs to bring deep domain context, regulatory awareness, and vertical-specific nuances into engagements. - Coordinate with the Technology Transformation team to ensure process changes are underpinned by the right technology architecture and infrastructure. - Work with the Process Engineering team on process mining, process modeling, simulation, and continuous improvement methodologies. - Align with the Data & Knowledge Services practice to ensure data readiness and knowledge layer integration for AI-powered process transformation.   Delivery Excellence & Solution Ownership - Own end-to-end solution design and delivery for large-scale business transformation programs across focus industries. - Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes - cost reduction, cycle time improvement, compliance adherence, error reduction, and enhanced customer experience. - Establish governance frameworks, transformation KPIs, and success metrics for every engagement. - Drive change management, organizational readiness, and adoption as integral components of every transformation program. - Change the world. Love your job.

title: Senior PCB Design Engineer
description:
About CynLr Just like a babys brain, CynLr Visual Intelligence stack makes Robots to instinctively see & pick any object under any ambience, without any training. Today, a robot that can fit a screw into a nut without slipping a thread, doesnt exist. Imagine what it would take for a robot to assemble a Smartphone or a car by putting together 1000s of parts with varied shapes and weights, all in random orientations. Thus, factories become complex, needing heavy customization of their environment. CynLr-enabled visual robots intuitively learn to handle even unknown objects, on-the-fly, eliminating the need for rigid fixtures, pre-training, or environment customization. This enables an universal alternative to custom automation thus simplifying factory lines into modular LEGO-like micro-factories that can be rapidly reconfigured as products change. At the core of CynLr lies a fundamentally new approach to machine vision. Unlike conventional vision systems that rely on image recognition and heuristics, CynLr s Vision and ML stacks are deeply inspired by neuroscience, modelling how biological vision understands shape, geometry, and interaction rather than appearance alone. To support this, CynLr builds its hardware, sensors, compute pipelines, and learning stacks from scratch, tightly coupling perception, decision-making, and action. This integration allows CynLr to operate in conditions that defeat traditional automation: variable lighting, cluttered environments, unknown objects, and high precision manipulation, unlocking automation use cases that have remained unsolved for decades. By rethinking vision as an intelligent, adaptive sense rather than a static tool, CynLr is redefining how robots perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world. 
 About the Role Product Design begins as a hypothetical concept. Transforming that concept into a functional Product is a highly creative and iterative process that requires a strong understanding of electrical fundamentals, physical constraints, and manufacturing realities. For any hardware product, the PCB is the physical backbone that defines electrical performance, reliability, thermal behaviour, manufacturability, and ultimately the products form factor and cost. Component selection, placement, stack-up, routing strategy, and manufacturability constraints together determine whether a design remains a prototype or becomes a scalable product. Engineering high-quality PCBs often requires going beyond standard reference designs and thumb rules balancing signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, thermal constraints, mechanical packaging, and manufacturing limitations. Geographically, we operate in an ecosystem where component availability, fabrication capabilities, and assembly quality vary significantly. This requires continuous engagement with PCB manufacturers, assembly houses, component vendors, and test partners to ensure designs are robust, manufacturable, and repeatable. You will be responsible for the design, validation, and manufacturing readiness of PCBs used across our products. The Product Design team will be your internal customer. 
 Your primary contribution will be toward Supporting CynLrs Product Design team with all Schematic, Layout, Library management and hardware development Translating system-level and schematic designs int o production-ready PCB layouts. Defining board stack-ups, layer counts, and material selections based on electrical and mechanical requirements. Performin g component placement and routing with focus on SI, PI, EMI/EMC, thermal, and mechanical constraints. Preparing and releasin g manufacturing and assembly documentation for prototype and production builds. Verification & Validation (V&V) Supporting electrical bring-up and validation of manufactured PCBs. Debugging board-level issues in collaboration with system and firmware teams. Interfacing with PCB manufacturers, assembly vendors, and component suppliers to ensure successful execution and timely delivery Acting as th e PCB design knowledge base for design engineers and freshers joining the organization. 
 Job Requirements Electronics Fundamentals: Strong understanding of digital and analog electronics. Solid understanding of schematic design practices and electrical constraints. Good understanding of signal integrity and power integrity fundamentals. Familiarity wi th high-speed digital interfaces and their PCB-level requirements. Understanding of EMI/EMC principles and mitigation techniques. Basic understanding of thermal management at the PCB level. PCB Design & Layout: Strong hands-on experience w ith PCB CAD tools (Altium, OrCAD, KiCad, or equivalent) Experience designing: Multilayer PCBs (Rigid, Flex and Rigid-Flex), High-density and fine-pitch component boards, Mixed-signal designs Experience with: Component placement optimization, Controlled impedance/ differential pair routing, Power plane and ground plane design Experience routing: High-speed interfaces (USB, Ethernet, PCIe, DDR, etc.), Power circuits and regulators Ability to handle complex, densely populated bo a rds. Verification and Validation: Experience suppor ting PCB bring-up and debugging . Ability to work with: Oscilloscopes, Logic analyzers, Multimeters. Experience reviewing and responding to SI/PI, EMI/EMC, and thermal analysis feedback. Ability to identify and correct layout-related issues during validation. Manufacturability & Documentation: Strong understandi ng of DFM, DFA, a nd DFT principles . Experience creating: Fabrication drawings, Assembly drawings, Gerbers /ODB++Pick-and-place files Experience working with PCB manufacturers and assembly houses for: Prototype builds, Production builds, Yield improvement and issue resolution. Vendor and Supply Chain: Exposure to PCB fabrication and assembly ecosystems (local and global). Experience reviewing BOMs for: Component availability, Alternate part selection, Lifecycle and obsolescence risks. Ability to interact with vendors during quoting, review, and build stages. What will you do? CynLr s vision system is central in the control loop of the vision guided manipulation platform. The stereo vision system is acquiring at 75 FPS and this means processing must also happen at this speed or higher and the processing method based on neural network is computationally intensive as it involves a high level of successive matrix multiplication. You will contribute in the system hardware design with PCB involving high speed interfaces like USB, EtherCAT, PCIE, etc. Your focus will be majorly on the PCB and Hardware design, working closely with Product Design team to build and deploy PCB's for embedded system, design evaluation boards for motor, encoder, camera and similar peripherals. You will also be contributing to product assembly and board bring up and validation along with mechanical CAD design to ensure proper packaging of PCB for IP related activities. It will be your responsibility to interact with vendors for PCB manufacturing, SI/PI, Assembly. You will define and execute verification and validation procedures, support prototypes and manufacturing builds, and ensure reliable system behaviour in real-world use. This role focuses on design, integration, evaluation and system validation. How will you do it? Though confined to a focused area, the work is pretty much expected to be entrepreneurial with the exact advantages and difficulties of a startup. Since this is a startup and the product will evolve at a rapid pace, the contours of the technology, toolchain & Process will have to constantly adapt to the changes. You will participate in actively contributing to building the process & tool chain too. You will have complete freedom here, but you will be subjected to reviews.

title: Sr Mixed Signal DV Engineer
description:
Change the world. Love your job. 
Texas Instruments is seeking Design Verification Engineer. In this role you will confirm the accuracy of designs for analog and mixed signal electronic parts, components, or integrated circuitry for analog and mixed signal electronic equipment and other hardware systems before pattern generation/mask development. The role will require working independently from the product development team who designed the devices to confirm adherence to known design rules, procedures, and best practices. Additional job functions include analyzing equipment to establish operating data and conducting experimental tests and evaluating results to confirm the device meets all requirements in the specifications. You may also run software simulations, selecting components and equipment based on analysis of specifications and reliability. As a Design Verification Engineer you may also review vendor capability to support product development. Requires a BS degree or equivalent experience in the design of equipment, components or circuitry. Who are we and what do we do The Advanced Circuits and Power Solutions business is known for delivering industry-leading custom IC system solutions, including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices, and high-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal chains and highly efficient power components into ultra-small form factors, enabling TI s best-in-class customers to translate their ideas into high-value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market. In this team, you will work with and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders who have influenced TI s technology, productivity, and way of working in creative and impactful ways. You will directly interact with one of TI s most valued, high-volume customers through intense technical reviews and architecture discussions! By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path. About the job If you are looking to join an ingenious, vigorous ambitious team that consistently delivers groundbreaking technologies into the custom mobile electronics world, here is an opportunity for you! What will you be doing in this role Strategic Technical Leadership Strategic Leadership: Drive TIs technology roadmap by collaborating with Process, Packaging, EDA, and other key stakeholders both within and outside the company. Industry Influence: Define and implement industry-leading best practices within TI and represent the companys technical leadership in front of key customers. Design Governance: Participate in the critical review and sign-off of designs developed within the team as well as cross-product designs across TI. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Architecture, Design, and Firmware teams to ensure successful product execution. Verification Strategy Architecture Verification Strategy: Drive the verification strategy by creating detailed test plans, defining test cases, checkers, and coverage metrics. Develop comprehensive, coverage-driven verification plans in close collaboration with System, Application, and Design teams. UVM Architecture: Lead the ground-up development of UVM-based verification environments, including the implementation of agents, drivers, monitors, and scoreboards. Mixed-Signal Methodology: Build and enhance mixed-signal testbenches using a combination of schematics, behavioral models, and RTL. Mixed-Signal Modeling Expertise Modeling Simulation: Create high-fidelity analog behavioral models using Verilog-A, Verilog-AMS, Wreal (RNM), or EENet to enable efficient top-level simulation. Analog Checkers Assertions: Implement real-time analog checkers and post-processing checker strategies to ensure functional correctness across domains. Protocol Expertise: Verify standard communication protocols such as I2C, ASI, SPI, and UART. Execution, Debug, Support Full-Cycle Execution: Execute RTL and Gate-Level Simulations (GLS), manage regressions, and track functional and code coverage (Block, Expression, Toggle, FSM) to ensure 100% closure through tape-out. Technical Debugging: Utilize advanced debugging and problem-solving skills to resolve complex design and testbench issues. Post-Silicon Support: Collaborate with Product and Application Engineering teams to support ATE functional pattern generation and silicon characterization. Minimum requirements: Minimum education Masters or Bachelors degree in electrical engineering Minimum of 12 years of experience Basic Requirements (Must-Haves) Core Competencies: Strong expertise in SystemVerilog (SV) and UVM methodologies. Mixed-Signal Modeling: Proficiency in analog behavioral modeling using Verilog-AMS, Verilog-A, or Wreal (RNM). Mixed-Signal Verification: Direct experience with mixed-signal verification flows involving a combination of schematics, behavioral models, and RTL. Tooling: Proficiency with Cadence simulation tools (e.g., Xcelium, vManager, JasperGold).   What we believe in 
 At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.   Your role and responsibilities: 
 In this role, you will execute warehousing activities for incoming and outgoing goods. Follow, and ensure that others also follow established procedures and guidelines to receive, handle, store, record and dispatch goods in the warehouse.   The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite   The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification, Smart Building Business to be based at Nelamangala, Bangalore India.    You will be mainly accountable for:   Warehouse & Inventory Management – Maintain accurate ERP data, control inventory, optimize warehouse capacity and floor utilization, and ensure effective stock management. Inbound Quality & Supplier Coordination – Check the quality of incoming materials, ensure proper storage, and maintain regular coordination with suppliers for timely material availability. Factory Feeding & Operational Support – Ensure timely material supply to the factory, support production requirements, and contribute to meeting monthly revenue and operational targets. Process, Productivity & KPI Management – Develop and maintain departmental work instructions, monitor productivity and KPIs, and implement actions to improve warehouse, workforce, and equipment efficiency. Digitalization & Continuous Improvement – Identify and implement warehouse and factory digitalization initiatives, carry out continual improvement activities, and develop innovative solutions to improve service quality and operational efficiency.   Qualifications for the role:   Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Electronics & Communication (EC), Electrical & Electronics (E&E), or a relevant engineering discipline. 8–15 years of experience in warehouse management and internal logistics operations in a manufacturing environment. Solid knowledge of inbound and outbound warehouse operations, ensuring safe, timely, and efficient material movement. Direct experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and good understanding of Lean methodologies and continuous improvement practices. Working knowledge of SAP and Microsoft Office applications for inventory, warehouse, and operational management. Demonstrated leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate, communicate, collaborate, and improve team performance. Solid problem-solving, methodical, interpersonal, and communication skills, with solid proficiency in English.   More about us:   ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

description:
Position Title- Loss Prevention - Assistant Manager Location - Ware house-7 & 7A, Dobbaspet 5th Phase, Sompura Industrial Area, Dobaspet Industrial Area, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka, 562111 Department- Loss Prevention & Security Reports To- Loss Prevention Head Experience Required- 4 - 5 years in loss prevention/security roles within retail, warehouse, or logistics operations Educational Qualification- Graduate in any discipline; background in security management, law enforcement, or ex-defence/paramilitary service preferred Employment Type- Full-Time 
 Job Overview- V2 Retail Limited is seeking an experienced Loss Prevention Assistant Manager to safeguard inventory, assets, and operations at its Bangalore Distribution Centre. The role holder will be responsible for designing and enforcing loss prevention protocols, managing physical security, investigating shrinkage and pilferage incidents, and building a culture of accountability and compliance across warehouse operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, implement, and enforce loss prevention policies and SOPs covering inward/outward material movement, employee access, and vehicle checks at the DC. Lead physical security operations including CCTV surveillance, security guard deployment, access control, and perameter security for the facility. Monitor and investigate incidents of shrinkage, pilferage, and inventory discrepancies; conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective measures. Conduct surprise audits and spot checks on inward/outward gate processes, employee bags/vehicles, and high-value merchandise storage areas. Track and report key loss prevention KPIs shrinkage percentage, incident counts, recovery rates, and audit compliance scores. Coordinate with local police and law enforcement authorities for incident reporting, investigations, and legal follow-up where required. Build and train a loss prevention/security team, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures and ethical conduct. Partner with Quality, Logistics, and Inventory teams to identify process gaps that contribute to loss and recommend systemic fixes. Ensure compliance with fire safety, emergency evacuation, and workplace security protocols in coordination with the Administration team. Prepare and present monthly loss prevention reports and incident summaries to DC and senior management. 
 Key Skills & Requirements 
 4-5 years of experience in loss prevention, security, or asset protection, preferably in a warehouse, retail, or logistics environment. Strong knowledge of physical security systems (CCTV, access control) and investigative techniques. Experience conducting shrinkage audits, incident investigations, and root-cause analysis. Working knowledge of relevant legal and law enforcement liaison procedures. Strong leadership skills with experience managing security/loss prevention teams on the ground. High integrity, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive investigations professionally. Good documentation, reporting, and communication skills.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION 
 Manager Procurement, Operations & Spares Position Summary The Supply Chain Manager will be responsible for leading Supply Chain Operations, Procurement Operations, and Spare Parts Procurement teams in India. This role will own the end-to-end execution of material flow from Purchase Order creation through supplier delivery, manufacturing, project fulfillment, and aftermarket support. The successful candidate will be accountable for ensuring material availability, maintaining strong supplier and contract manufacturer relationships, driving on-time delivery, and supporting manufacturing, planning, engineering, logistics, finance, and service teams. The role requires a leader who takes ownership, drives accountability, removes bottlenecks, and consistently delivers business commitments on time. 
 This position will manage both project procurement and spare parts procurement functions while leading a team focused on operational excellence, execution, and continuous improvement. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Supply Chain Execution Own end-to-end material execution from PO placement through supplier delivery, manufacturing, and project fulfillment. Ensure material availability to support production schedules, project milestones, and customer commitments. Drive on-time delivery performance across suppliers, contract manufacturers, and logistics partners. Proactively identify supply risks and execute mitigation and recovery plans. Lead supply reviews and ensure timely closure of shortages, delays, and operational bottlenecks. 2. Supplier & Contract Manufacturer Management Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and contract manufacturers. Drive supplier accountability for delivery, quality, responsiveness, and capacity commitments. Conduct regular supplier performance reviews and implement corrective actions where required. Lead escalations and negotiate delivery commitments, lead-time reductions, and recovery plans. Partner with suppliers to improve service, reliability, and operational performance. 3. Cross-Functional Leadership Work closely with Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Finance, and Project teams. Ensure alignment between supply plans, production schedules, and project requirements. Support Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), New Product Introductions (NPIs), and supplier transitions. Drive issue resolution and remove barriers impacting execution. 4. Spares Procurement & Aftermarket Operations Lead Spare Parts Procurement and Operations supporting global service and aftermarket requirements. Ensure timely availability and delivery of spare parts to meet customer service commitments. Partner with Service, Planning, Warehousing, and Logistics teams to maintain optimal inventory levels. Drive improvements in spare parts forecasting, inventory management, procurement processes, and fulfillment performance. Manage critical spare part shortages and ensure rapid recovery actions. 5. Team Leadership & People Development Lead and develop teams supporting Procurement Operations, Supply Chain Operations, Spares Procurement, and Analytics. Establish clear goals, KPIs, and accountability across the team. Effectively prioritize workload, delegate responsibilities, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Coach and mentor team members while fostering a culture of ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement. 6. Data, Reporting & Operational Excellence Analyze supply chain performance to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop reporting and dashboards to track key operational metrics. Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure data accuracy and integrity across supply chain systems and reports. Support implementation of ERP and supply chain process enhancements. 7. Stakeholder Communication & Escalation Management Provide clear and timely communication on supply risks, project status, and recovery plans. Escalate critical issues with actionable mitigation strategies. Maintain strong engagement with regional and global stakeholders. Ensure transparency, accountability, and execution discipline across all supply chain activities. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing Operations, or Program Management. 5+ years of experience managing teams and driving operational performance. Proven experience managing suppliers, contract manufacturers, and global supply chains. Strong knowledge of procurement, planning, inventory management, logistics, and manufacturing operations. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle ERP, or equivalent. Strong understanding of MRP and supply planning processes. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI or similar platforms. Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Master's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or Business Administration. Experience in manufacturing, energy storage, renewable energy, electronics, or industrial sectors. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, APICS, or related supply chain methodologies. Experience leading process improvement and transformation initiatives. Critical Success Factors The ideal candidate will demonstrate: Strong ownership and accountability. Excellent supplier and stakeholder management skills. Ability to influence and drive results across cross-functional teams. Strong execution and follow-through. Effective delegation and team leadership. Proactive risk management and escalation handling. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to on-time delivery. Experience balancing project procurement, manufacturing requirements, and spare parts operations. Success in this role will be measured by: On-time project delivery. Material availability and supply continuity. Supplier and contract manufacturer performance. Spare parts service levels and inventory health. Team productivity and operational efficiency. Stakeholder satisfaction and business impact. 

 This role is for a hands-on leader who takes ownership of outcomes, drives accountability across suppliers and internal teams, and ensures projects, production schedules, and customer commitments are delivered on time, every time.

 WAREHOUSE EXECUTIVE Job Summary The Purchase & Store Executive, based at the Warehouse, will be responsible for end-to-end coordination and oversight of procurement and warehouse operations across Magnolia Bakery locations in Bangalore. This role plays a critical part in ensuring timely procurement, inter-city stock movement, and centralized control over warehouse inventory, hygiene, documentation, and compliance. The role involves close coordination with central kitchens, warehouse teams, and vendors in each city to ensure seamless backend support to operations. Key Roles and Responsibilities 1. Procurement Coordination Coordinate with central kitchen and warehouse teams gather material requirements. Raise purchase requests, obtain quotations, and issue purchase orders in line with defined policies. Negotiate pricing, delivery terms, and credit periods with vendors and maintain updated vendor records. Track and ensure timely delivery of materials, coordinate with city teams for follow-ups and delivery receipts. Coordinate transfers of stock between locations when required and ensure proper documentation. Resolve warehouse-level issues and escalate chronic discrepancies or delays to the supply chain head. 3. Inventory Control & Reporting Generate consolidated inventory and stock movement reports across all cities for review by management. Analyze stock variances, wastage, or obsolescence and work with local teams to address root causes. Support and audit periodic physical stock checks and cycle counts conducted by city warehouse teams. Maintain central records of purchases, consumption, vendor performance, and pricing history. 4. Interdepartmental & Intercity Coordination Work closely with central kitchen, finance, and warehouse personnel in all three locations. Coordinate intercity dispatches, logistics support, and material requirement planning. Escalate urgent needs or critical shortages and drive timely resolution through internal teams or vendors. Contribute to SOP improvement for procurement and warehouse control, with a focus on scalability and standardization. Hours of work for this position are approximately 54-60 hours per week including 1 hour break every day. Basic understanding of procurement processes, vendor management, and inventory control. Knowledge of food cost, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), and stock management principles. Familiarity with food safety, sanitation standards, and proper storage procedures (especially for F&B operations). Ability to monitor stock levels, conduct stock counts, and maintain accurate inventory records. Experience in handling purchase orders, goods receiving, invoice verification, and documentation. Strong organizational skills with good time management and attention to detail. Ability to manage supplies across multiple outlets or locations (if required). Good communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate with vendors, kitchen teams, and management. Capable of handling supplier negotiations and resolving discrepancies or damage claims. description:
Internal Auditor -Business Operations Description - Job Summary 
 The Auditor applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues within established guidelines and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May provide direction to team activities and facilitate information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment within generally defined policies and practices to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle unique situations. This role is responsible for assessing systems and processes, identifying key risks and internal controls, conducting tests, documenting findings, and proposing recommendations for designated areas. The role excels in interviewing to gather insights about business processes and inherent risks. The role evaluates and suggests audit approaches, engages in research, shares analytical insights, and provides progress updates. The role also analyzes audit data, fosters positive relationships, assesses technology integration, solves complex problems, and may lead simple projects or parts of projects while delivering reports and supporting operational plans.

Performs all audit activities that involve identifying inherent and residual risks and helps conduct risk-based assurance and advisory projects. Responsible for reviewing internal controls, conducting test work, documenting standard operating procedures and findings, and drafting recommendations for assigned areas. Completes all the job tasks within the defined timelines, anticipating and addressing conflicts or dependencies in a complex setting, and monitoring and communicating progress. Effectively conducts interviews to gather information about HP business processes and associated risks. Reviews and recommends audit approaches and tools to use during assurance and advisory engagements. Works towards enhancing the current audit methodologies, internal controls, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining intended results. Can identify key performance indicators and opportunities for continuous control monitoring. Able to design a complex audit work program effectively that is sufficient for re-performance with limited input from the manager. Actively researches, shares analysis, and provides regular updates on project accomplishments and impediments. Analyzes audit data and provides formally written audit results reports and recommendations to management. Able to clearly document issues, assess impacts, and determine root causes. Able to explain input and output of systems and processes and understands how to assess the risks associated with inputs and processing. Stays abreast of industry knowledge and HP IA environment, new audit developments, policies and standards, systems and applications used, benchmarks, emerging risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, fraud) and trends in audit scope. Applies knowledge of automation and process improvement, including the use of AI-enabled methodologies. Provides subject matter support and supervises beginner auditors in specific audit areas. Assists team in developing technical and professional competencies. Able to express and explain complex audits. Keeps pace with technical and operational innovation and change. This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.   Key Responsibilities Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events. Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations. Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers. Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making. Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers. Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk. Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates. Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations. Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework. Hospitality & Industry Expertise Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting. Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including: Guest room blocks and pickup analysis Attrition and cancellation clauses Food & Beverage minimum commitments Meeting room rental structures Complimentary ratios and concession strategies Revenue displacement and peak period pricing Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success. Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions. Stakeholder Management Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives. Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle. Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases. Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners. Supplier Performance & Governance Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations. Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities. Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources. Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships. Reporting & Process Improvement Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management. Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies. Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.   Education Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred. Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.   Experience Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing. Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects. Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers. Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices. Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.   Skills & Competencies Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology. Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset. Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.  Cloud Platform Operations Specialist (Azure & AWS) Grade D Country 
 India Service Line Group 
 Group Digital Overview 
 Cloud Engineering within Group Digital provides build and run capabilities for enterprise cloud platforms. This includes platform automation, DevOps tooling, CI/CD enablement, security baseline implementation, and operational support across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. The Cloud Platform Operations capability provides the operational management of enterprise cloud platforms, ensuring consistent execution of platform administration, service requests, access management, and day-to-day operational activities across the Firm's cloud estate. The team delivers operational services that enable secure, compliant, and efficient consumption of cloud platforms while supporting engineering teams, business stakeholders, and managed service providers. The Cloud Platform Operations capability is responsible for the operational administration of Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud platforms. This includes execution of standard operational requests, cloud account lifecycle management, identity and access administration, platform governance activities, and operational support to ensure cloud services remain secure, compliant, and available. The team manages the day-to-day operational administration of enterprise cloud platforms, including cloud account provisioning, access management, platform configuration, identity administration, licensing, billing administration, and operational support. Operating within a multi-supplier delivery model, the team collaborates closely with Cloud Engineering, Security, Architecture, Service Management, Identity teams, vendors, and managed service providers to deliver consistent and efficient cloud operations while maintaining compliance with enterprise governance and security standards. The role performs cloud platform administration, fulfils operational service requests, manages cloud account lifecycle activities, administers platform access and permissions, and supports day-to-day platform operations. Working within established operational procedures and governance frameworks, the individual ensures cloud services are administered accurately, securely, and consistently while providing operational support to internal stakeholders and contributing to continuous service improvement initiatives. title: Logistics Officer (Male)
description:
Urgent opening for Logistics Officer (Male) with Singapore MNC Job Title: Logistics Officer 
 Gender: Male 
 Location: Bangalore 
 Experience: 3-7 Years 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Education: Graduate/Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Commerce, or related field . Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and responsible Logistics Officer to manage and coordinate end-to-end logistics operations, including machinery and spare parts movement, domestic and international shipments, import processes, documentation, invoicing, GST compliance, and e-way bill generation . The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in logistics operations and a good understanding of machinery/spare parts handling, import documentation, transportation, inventory movement, GST rules, and statutory logistics documentation . Key Responsibilities 
 1. Logistics & Shipment Management Manage end-to-end logistics activities for machinery, equipment, and spare parts . Coordinate domestic and international shipments with transporters, freight forwarders, courier agencies, and clearing agents. Plan and monitor dispatches, deliveries, and material movement. Track shipments and ensure timely delivery to customers/sites. Coordinate loading, unloading, packing, and transportation of machinery and spare parts. Maintain proper records of all incoming and outgoing shipments. 
 2. Import & Export Coordination Handle and coordinate import shipments from order placement to final delivery. Coordinate with freight forwarders, CHA/customs agents, shipping lines, and suppliers. Manage import-related documentation such as Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading/Airway Bill, Certificate of Origin, and other required documents . Track shipment status, customs clearance, and delivery timelines. Coordinate with internal teams for documentation required for customs clearance. Verify import invoices and associated logistics/freight charges. 
 3. Invoice & Documentation Process Prepare and verify logistics and material invoices and supporting documents. Ensure invoices contain correct GST, HSN/SAC, quantity, value, and other statutory details. Coordinate with accounts/finance teams for invoice processing and payment documentation. Maintain proper records of purchase, sales, transport, and shipment documents. Ensure documentation is accurate and completed within timelines. 
 4. GST & E-Way Bill Compliance Generate and manage E-Way Bills for movement of goods. Ensure compliance with applicable GST rules and regulations related to transportation and movement of goods. Verify GSTIN, HSN codes, taxable values, tax rates, and other invoice details. Coordinate with the accounts team regarding GST-related logistics documentation. Monitor validity of e-way bills and arrange extensions/corrections whenever required. Maintain proper records for audit and compliance purposes. 
 5. Machinery & Spare Parts Handling Coordinate logistics for heavy machinery, industrial equipment, components, and spare parts . Understand the nature, dimensions, weight, and handling requirements of machinery and spare parts. Select appropriate transportation based on material type, size, weight, urgency, and destination. Coordinate special transportation requirements for oversized/heavy machinery when required. Ensure safe and timely movement of high-value equipment and spare parts. 
 6. Vendor & Transporter Coordination Coordinate with transporters and logistics vendors for quotations, bookings, pickups, and deliveries. Negotiate transportation rates where required and maintain competitive logistics costs. Monitor transporter performance and resolve delivery-related issues. Maintain a database of approved transporters, freight forwarders, and logistics vendors. Verify freight bills against agreed rates and shipment details. 
 7. MIS & Reporting Maintain daily/weekly/monthly logistics reports. Track pending shipments, deliveries, imports, freight costs, and material movements. Maintain shipment and logistics documentation for future reference and audits. Provide regular updates to management regarding shipment status and logistics issues. Identify opportunities to improve logistics efficiency and reduce transportation costs.

Key Skills: handling machinery and industrial spare parts,generating E-Way Bills,import shipments and import documentation,GST Compliance,Spares Management,Shipping,Gst,Spare parts

title: Workplace Investigator - MEA / APAC / NA
description:
The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, Integrity is an independent and objective organization that forms an integral part of the Legal Integrity Function. We are expanding our team to strengthen our focus on workplace-related investigations. The team is responsible for receiving and managing allegations involving employee misconduct and violations of the Code of Conduct, overseeing the full investigation lifecycle, and supporting appropriate disciplinary and remediation actions. As a Senior Investigator - Workplace Related Matters, you will play a critical role in conducting complex, multi-jurisdictional workplace investigations that may impact employees, business operations, and the company''s reputation. Working closely with Legal, Integrity, HR, and other stakeholders, you will lead investigations from intake through closure while fostering a culture of integrity and accountability across the organization. How You''ll Make an Impact Conduct workplace-related investigations under the direction of the Head of OSI - Labor/Workplace Related Matters, independently or in collaboration with other Special Investigations Officers, Legal Integrity, and HR teams. Manage end-to-end investigative processes, including allegation assessment, evidence gathering, data collection, forensic analysis, witness interviews, documentation, and case closure. Interview whistleblowers, witnesses, impacted employees, and subjects in a professional, objective, and confidential manner. Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive investigation reports and present findings to relevant stakeholders. Engage and communicate with disciplinary committees at various levels across the organization. Support investigations across regional and, when required, global locations. Deliver training and capability-building sessions for Legal Integrity and HR teams to strengthen workplace investigation skills. Provide ongoing guidance and support to HR teams on workplace-related matters. Identify lessons learned from investigations and contribute to the enhancement of internal controls and risk mitigation measures. Support the continued development and maturity of the Integrity investigation function. Travel up to 10% as required to support investigation activities. Your Background Bachelor''s degree in Law, Human Resources, Audit, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 8 years of experience conducting corporate or workplace investigations. Strong understanding of workplace misconduct investigations, employee relations matters, and fact-finding methodologies. Experience managing investigations from intake through reporting and resolution. Preferred professional background in Law, Human Resources, Compliance, Integrity, Ethics, Audit, or a related discipline. Experience working with eDiscovery and investigation tools such as Relativity, ZyLAB, or similar platforms. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong analytical, interviewing, documentation, and report-writing capabilities. Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple investigations and deliver results within established deadlines. High level of integrity, independent judgment, attention to detail, resilience, and professionalism. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across cultures and geographies while maintaining objectivity and confidentiality. Ability to build trust and collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the organization. Based in Bangalore, India. More About Us At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to fostering an ethical, inclusive, and collaborative work environment. We offer a dynamic opportunity within a global organization where professional development and continuous learning are highly valued. You will have the opportunity to take on meaningful responsibilities, contribute to a growing function, and work alongside experienced professionals dedicated to upholding the highest standards of integrity. We provide a competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with your skills and experience.

Key Skills: administration,interviewing,employee relations,internal controls,ediscovery,human resources,data collection,forensic analysis

description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an Executive Inventory to manage day-to-day inventory operations at the warehouse. The role will be responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, monitoring stock movement, conducting physical stock counts, resolving inventory discrepancies, and ensuring smooth coordination between warehouse, operations, and supply chain teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage and monitor day-to-day inventory operations at the warehouse. Maintain accurate records of inward, outward, transfer, and return inventory . Ensure proper GRN, stock transfer, picking, put-away, and dispatch processes. Conduct regular physical stock counts / cycle counts and reconcile the same with system inventory. Identify and investigate stock discrepancies, shortages, excess stock, damages, and mismatches . Ensure proper SKU-wise inventory tracking and storage . Monitor inventory ageing, slow-moving, non-moving, and damaged stock . Coordinate with Warehouse, Operations, SCM, and Finance teams for inventory-related issues. Maintain and update daily inventory reports, MIS, and stock reconciliation reports . Ensure proper FIFO / FEFO practices wherever applicable. Support monthly stock audits and inventory reconciliation . Ensure proper documentation and system updates for all inventory movements. Monitor RTO / returns inventory and ensure timely reconciliation and disposition. Support warehouse teams in maintaining proper bin locations and inventory organization . Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve inventory accuracy and operational efficiency . Ensure compliance with defined SOPs, inventory controls, and warehouse processes . 
 Required Skills 
 Strong knowledge of Inventory Management and Warehouse Operations . Good understanding of stock reconciliation and cycle counting . Strong MS Excel skills – VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/SUMIFS, basic MIS. Experience working on WMS / ERP / Inventory Management systems . Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment. Good attention to detail and accuracy. 
 Preferred Experience

description:
Job Title: Student Relationship Manager 
 Entry-Level | Individual Contributor | Campus-Based 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Student Relationship Manager to be the single, non-academic point of contact for a mapped cohort of around 180 students on campus. This is an entry-level, high-visibility role for someone calm under pressure who genuinely enjoys helping people and owns a problem until it's actually closed not just logged. You'll be the first person students turn to for anything outside the classroom: hostel, mess, transport, fees, documentation, campus facilities, or simply needing to be heard. 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 0–1 years of experience — freshers are encouraged to apply Any graduate (bachelor's degree), any academic stream Excellent verbal and written communication skills Natural empathy and active listening — able to hear someone out fully without rushing to judgment or a canned response Calm and steady under pressure Proactive and self-starting — follows up and closes loops without needing to be chased Comfortable with basic tracker/spreadsheet discipline and a weekly reporting rhythm Willing to be based on campus full-time and work the academic calendar — this is not a remote or hybrid role 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a people-facing or service role — even part-time, an internship, or volunteering Familiarity with student life, hostels, or a residential campus environment 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Be the single point of contact every mapped student knows to go to for any non-academic issue Log, categorize, and route issues to the right owner (facilities, warden, finance, transport) with an SLA, and track to closure Run a standing cadence of check-ins to catch disengagement, attendance drops, or dissatisfaction early Own the NPS of the mapped cohort — run the feedback loop and act on what's driving detractor scores Liaise with campus administration and facility vendors on recurring issues Maintain a live issue tracker and share a weekly dashboard with Program Ops 
 Ideal Backgrounds Psychology, social work, HR, or hospitality management graduates; BPO/voice and chat customer service freshers; hospitality and aviation entry-role candidates (front office, guest relations, cabin crew trainees); campus placement candidates with strong extracurricular signals (NSS, student council, peer counselling); ed-tech/ed-services customer success or student-counselling freshers. Growth Path Strong performers with consistent NPS ownership and tracker discipline are the natural pipeline into the Student Relationship Senior Manager role as regions expand.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
About the Role Pump Academy Private Limited (PAPL) is seeking an experienced and self-driven Senior Systems Administrator to strengthen and manage its multi-site IT infrastructure. The incumbent will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, maintenance, and security of hardware, software, cloud platforms, and network assets across PAPL's office locations. This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role requiring the ability to independently manage IT operations under a formal Information Security Management System (ISMS) aligned to ISO 27001:2022, while ensuring compliance with applicable legal and regulatory frameworks including the Information Technology Act, 2000. 
 Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Systems Administration Plan, deploy, configure, and maintain Windows/Linux servers (physical and virtual) across primary and branch office locations. Administer and support virtualisation environments (VMware / Hyper-V) and ensure high availability of critical systems. Manage storage systems, backup solutions, and disaster recovery (DR) procedures; conduct and document periodic DR drills. Maintain system and server documentation, asset registers, and configuration records in the ITSM/ITAM platform. Coordinate hardware procurement, vendor engagement, and warranty/AMC tracking for all IT assets. 
 Cloud Administration (AWS & Azure) Administer Microsoft Azure environments including Azure AD (Entra ID), Intune, conditional access, and identity governance. Manage AWS workloads EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch ensuring cost optimisation and security best practices. Implement and maintain cloud security controls, access policies, and resource tagging standards. Support hybrid cloud integration between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms. 
 Microsoft 365 Administration Manage the full Microsoft 365 tenant: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune MDM/MAM. Administer licensing, mailbox configuration, retention policies, DLP rules, and conditional access policies. Provide Level 2/3 support for Microsoft Teams voice, channels, meetings, and telephony integration. Conduct periodic M365 security assessments using Microsoft Secure Score and Defender for Office 365. 
 Network Infrastructure Configure, monitor, and maintain firewalls (Fortinet / SonicWall / Cisco ASA or equivalent), VPNs, and perimeter security. Manage Layer 2/3 switching infrastructure — VLAN segmentation, STP, inter-VLAN routing, and port security. Administer and troubleshoot Wi-Fi access points — configuration, coverage planning, captive portal, and guest network isolation. Monitor network performance using SNMP-based or equivalent NMS tools; respond to alerts and capacity issues proactively. Manage ISP links, WAN failover, and QoS configurations across multiple sites. 
 Physical & Peripheral Infrastructure Maintain and support printers, MFDs, scanners, and print server configurations for all offices. Manage CCTV/IP surveillance systems — installation, health checks, footage retention policy, and NVR administration. Oversee structured cabling, patch panel management, and rack organisation standards. Maintain UPS, PDUs, and server room environmental monitoring systems. 
 Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance Operate within the organisation's ISMS framework; implement and maintain controls per ISO 27001:2022 Annex A requirements. Participate in internal audits, risk assessments, and VAPT activities; track and close non-conformities and OFIs. Enforce endpoint security — EDR/antivirus deployment, patch management, USB control, and device hardening baselines. Administer identity and access management (IAM) — provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access control, and periodic access reviews. Assist in preparation of audit evidence, SOA mappings, and control documentation for external ISO audits. Support implementation of the IT Act 2000 and DPDP Act 2023 obligations including data classification, retention, and incident reporting. 
 IT Support & Service Management Act as an escalation point for Level 2 and Level 3 helpdesk incidents; mentor junior IT support staff. Log, track, and close incidents, service requests, and change requests in the ITSM platform per defined SLAs. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions. Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge base articles, and runbooks for all administered systems. 
 Multi-Site Operations & Travel Perform periodic on-site visits to branch offices for infrastructure audits, hardware refresh, and support activities. Coordinate with branch IT contacts to ensure consistency of configurations and security baselines across all locations. Plan and execute equipment deployments, network changes, and site upgrades with minimal business disruption. 
 Required Qualifications & Skills Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline. Relevant professional certifications are strongly preferred (see below). 
 Experience 5 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure administration within a corporate or enterprise environment. Demonstrated experience managing IT under an ISO 27001-certified ISMS — mandatory. Experience supporting multi-site, multi-user environments with diverse hardware and software stacks. 
 Technical Skills — Mandatory Microsoft 365 Administration (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Azure AD / Entra ID). Firewall administration — policy management, VPN configuration, zone-based security (any major vendor). AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud platform administration. Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) — AD DS, DNS, DHCP, GPO, file services, and print services. Network switches — VLAN, spanning tree, 802.1X, port mirroring, QoS. Wireless access point administration — enterprise-grade (Cisco/Ruckus/UniFi or equivalent). CCTV/IP camera systems — NVR configuration, retention policy enforcement, health monitoring. Endpoint management — patch management, EDR deployment, device compliance policy. Peripheral device management — printers, MFDs, and print servers. Backup and recovery tools — configuration, monitoring, and DR testing. 
 Technical Skills — Good to Have Linux server administration (Ubuntu / RHEL / CentOS). Scripting for automation — PowerShell, Bash, or Python. SIEM/log management tools — Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or equivalent. MDM/MAM solutions — Microsoft Intune or JAMF. ITSM platforms — ServiceNow, Freshservice, or in-house equivalents. Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) and AV integration administration. 
 Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge Working knowledge of the Information Technology Act, 2000 and its amendments. Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. Understanding of ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls and audit processes. Awareness of ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 as they relate to IT process interfaces (preferred, not mandatory). 
 Preferred Certifications CompTIA Security+ or Network+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-102) AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor CCNA or equivalent networking certification 
 Key Competencies Ownership mindset — able to manage systems end-to-end without constant supervision. Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across diverse technology domains. Effective communicator — able to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Process discipline — comfortable working within audit-driven, documentation-heavy environments. Adaptability — ability to context-switch across infrastructure, security, and support tasks as priorities shift. Willingness to travel inter-city at short notice for site visits and support activities. 
 What PAPL Offers A high-ownership, low-bureaucracy environment where your work has direct organisational impact. Exposure to a diverse technology stack across on-premises, cloud, and physical security domains. Opportunity to contribute to ongoing ISO 27001:2022 certification and compliance initiatives. A collaborative, professional work culture with scope for growth into senior security or IT leadership roles.

title: Commercial Operations Associate
description:
Job Summary The Customer Support Executive is responsible for accurate and timely execution of customer orders from order receipt through invoice. The role coordinates quotations, proforma invoices, order processing, delivery follow-up, local vendor supplies and customer communication to support on-time delivery, customer satisfaction and backlog liquidation. The position works across internal functions and external vendors to ensure orders are processed error-free in Oracle and ServiceMax, risks are identified early, and customers receive clear, timely updates. This position reports to the Operations Manager and is part of the operations located in Bengaluru and will be an on-site role. In this role, you will have the opportunity to: Execute the complete order-to-invoice cycle, including order validation, entry, amendments, shipment coordination, invoicing and document closure. Prepare and send accurate customer quotations and proforma invoices within agreed turnaround times, ensuring commercial details, taxes, pricing and terms are correctly reflected. Process transactions accurately in Oracle and ServiceMax, maintain complete records, and prevent order-entry, billing and documentation errors through disciplined checks. Monitor open orders and proactively liquidate backlog by resolving holds, coordinating material availability and escalating delivery risks with clear ownership and follow-up. Coordinate with logistics, supply chain, sales, service, finance and other stakeholders to improve on-time delivery and reduce lead time from order receipt to shipment. Manage local procurement requirements by obtaining vendor quotations, placing and tracking supply requests, validating documentation and supporting timely receipt of locally supplied items. Provide responsive customer communication on order status, delivery commitments, documentation and issue resolution, while supporting customer satisfaction and continuous process improvement. Essential requirements Bachelor s degree in any stream from a recognized institution. Good written and verbal communication skills in English and verbal fluency in one or two regional languages. 5+ years of customer service, order management or order execution experience, including hands-on responsibility for order-to-invoice activities, customer communication and delivery coordination. Working experience with an enterprise resource planning system, preferably Oracle, and a field service or service management platform such as ServiceMax; proficiency in standard office productivity tools Excel and operational reporting. It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in Life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices or another regulated customer-service environment. Local vendor coordination, backlog reduction, quotation management and proforma invoice processing.

description:
Job Summary Kuku FM is looking for an AI Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it's about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one. You'll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment. Responsibilities Storytelling & Editing Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences.
