Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships. Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention. Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing. Mobile-First Storytelling Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing. Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact. Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption. AI Video & VFX Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots. Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues. Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement. Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated. Visual & Sound Finishing Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching. Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required. Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact. Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments. Production & Collaboration Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity. Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline. Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers. Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines. Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters. Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications. What We're Looking For Must Have 2-5 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content. Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish. Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills. Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics. Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management. Strong understanding of narrative structure, screen direction, continuity, performance selection, montage, shot progression, and visual rhythm. Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers. Strong understanding of audience retention and mobile-first 9:16 storytelling. Experience working with both live-action and AI-generated footage. Strong understanding of sound editing, dialogue balancing, music placement, ambience, Foley, and SFX. Ability to colour-match footage from different cameras, tools, and production pipelines. Strong eye for character, facial, costume, prop, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and background continuity. Ability to manage multiple episodes, revisions, and deadlines in a high-volume production environment. AI Experience Experience with generative AI video/image, lip-sync, cleanup, enhancement, upscaling, interpolation, shot extension, and compositing workflows is highly preferred. Preferred Qualifications Fluent Hindi and working proficiency in English. Experience with micro-dramas, vertical dramas, episodic fiction, web series, or retention-driven entertainment. Experience in fast-turnaround, high-volume episodic production. Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing, localisation, and multilingual versioning. Knowledge of proxy workflows, shared storage, media relinking, project templates, automated syncing, and structured post-production handoffs. Basic understanding of OTT and digital-platform delivery standards. Film editing, filmmaking, media production, animation, or related degree/diploma is a plus, but not mandatory.

 About Vijaya Enterprises Vijaya Enterprises is an established civil construction and real estate company with more than 50 years of industry experience . We are looking for a mature, disciplined and dependable Office General Manager who can take responsibility for the day-to-day administration and coordination of our office and construction-related activities. This position is particularly suited to someone who brings substantial professional and life experience , strong discipline and the ability to independently manage people, administrative matters and routine operational responsibilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Office Administration Manage the day-to-day functioning of the office. Ensure office discipline, punctuality and smooth coordination between staff and management. Handle routine administrative matters and follow up on pending activities. Maintain office records, documents and important files. Coordinate with contractors, vendors, suppliers and other external parties as required. Ensure that important tasks and commitments are followed up and completed on time. 
 2. Accounts & Financial Administration Supervise basic day-to-day accounts and financial administration. Monitor payments, receipts, expenses and outstanding amounts. Coordinate with the accountant/CA and provide necessary information and documentation. Maintain records of office and project-related expenses. Follow up on supplier bills, payments and pending accounts. Basic understanding of accounting software and computer applications is preferred. 
 3. Staff Management Supervise office staff and ensure punctuality, discipline and proper work practices. Allocate and follow up on routine responsibilities. Monitor attendance and staff requirements. Ensure that employees complete assigned work within the required timelines. Act as a point of coordination between management and office staff. 
 4. Construction & Site Coordination Have a basic practical understanding of civil construction and building materials . Coordinate with site personnel and management regarding day-to-day requirements. Ensure that site-related requirements are communicated and followed up promptly. Monitor important timelines and ensure that site activities are not unnecessarily delayed. Where required, coordinate with suppliers and ensure that materials reach the site on time. 
 5. Purchase & Supply Chain Coordination The candidate may also be involved in basic procurement and supply coordination for construction materials such as: Cement Paint Building blocks Steel and other construction materials Plumbing and electrical materials Other routine building and finishing materials 
 Responsibilities may include coordinating with suppliers, following up on orders and ensuring timely delivery to the required site. 
 Site & Time Management The candidate must be highly punctual and disciplined . Ensure that required personnel, materials and arrangements are in place before scheduled site activities. Reach the site/office at the required time whenever necessary. Anticipate potential delays and take timely action to prevent them. Follow up proactively rather than waiting for instructions. Understand that punctuality and timely coordination are critical in the construction industry. 
 Candidate Profile We are looking for a mature, responsible and experienced individual rather than someone selected purely on educational qualifications. 
 Our preference is for: Candidates aged 45 years and above . Candidates with substantial work and life experience. Strong discipline, punctuality and integrity. Good people-management and communication skills. Ability to work independently and take responsibility. Practical understanding of office administration. Basic computer knowledge, including email, MS Office/Excel and other routine office applications. Basic knowledge of civil construction and building materials. Ability to communicate effectively with staff, contractors, suppliers and site personnel. Candidates who are comfortable working in a traditional, professionally managed construction business. 
 Government / Public Sector Experience Candidates who have taken voluntary retirement (VRS) from government services or have retired from a government organisation are particularly welcome to apply, especially where they have demonstrated: Strong discipline and punctuality Administrative experience Staff-management experience Responsibility and accountability Experience handling records, accounts or departmental operations However, government experience is not mandatory . Candidates from the private sector and construction industry with strong practical experience are equally welcome. 
 Education Formal educational qualifications are not the primary selection criterion for this position. We value experience, maturity, discipline, reliability and practical knowledge more than academic qualifications. 
 Required Skills Office administration Staff supervision and management Basic accounts management Basic computer knowledge MS Excel / Word and email Vendor and supplier coordination Basic construction-material knowledge Site coordination Good communication skills Strong follow-up ability Punctuality and discipline 
 Personal Qualities We Value The ideal candidate should be: Disciplined • Punctual • Honest • Responsible • Practical • Dependable • Mature • Organised • Proactive 
 We are looking for someone who can become a trusted senior member of the organisation and handle day-to-day responsibilities with minimal supervision. 
 Location Requirement Candidates must be based in Bengaluru. The position requires regular attendance at the office from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM , with occasional site visits or site coordination as required. Candidates should be comfortable commuting to the office every working day and should not have any difficulty with the required working hours.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Operations
description:
Senior Analyst - Credit Operations 
 Responsibilities 
Own weekly reporting on the borrower funnel: Application Completion Rate, Offer Acceptance Rate, TAT, and stage-level drop-off. Root-cause funnel bottlenecks from registration to disbursal and propose fixes with sized impact. Own retention and repeat-borrower analysis: cohort trends, churn drivers, early-warning signals. Design and run retention tests, and report results against a stated baseline. Analyse collections performance - recovery rate by DPD bucket, in-house vs agency allocation, agent-level productivity - and hand the collections team ranked priorities. Run reconciliations across disbursements, repayments, and fund movements, clearing discrepancies with IT. Track tele-sales, support, and voicebot performance against target: FRT, CSAT, conversion throughput. Build and maintain the reporting and automation layer - SQL, dashboards, AI tooling - that turns raw data into decision-ready recommendations. 
 6-12 Month Expectations 
 Registration-to-Disbursal conversion improved by 5 percentage points, off the drop-off diagnostic that drove it. Month-on-month repeat-borrower retention held at 15% every month and reaching 20% by month 12, off a documented cohort and churn analysis. Reconciliation and the tele-sales readout (FRT, CSAT, conversion) running as standing processes, with zero unexplained discrepancies and zero SLA breaches. 
 Who We Are Looking For 
 3-5 years in business operations, product, or web/app analytics within digital consumer lending or a high-growth fintech. Hands-on SQL plus Python or Apps Script: writes and runs own queries against raw tables, builds automations with no dependency on an engineer. Advanced daily use of AI tools: drafting and stress-testing queries, running automations, building dashboards and readable reports. Broke down an ambiguous operational problem against large, messy data and defended the recommendation to the people who had to act on it. Written SOPs and process notes that a team then ran on. Working knowledge of the Indian digital lending ecosystem and core credit concepts: DPD buckets, disbursal flow, repayment and collection mechanics. Track record of switching between analysis and hands-on execution - this is not an advisory role. Fluent in English.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Layout Design
description:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Layout Design Engineer with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal layout for power and analog IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, independent judgment, and the ability to lead layout execution for complex blocks and full-chip designs. The successful candidate will translate circuit requirements into robust, manufacturable layouts for products such as PMICs, linear and switching regulators, gate drivers, battery-management ICs, and other power and analog devices. The role requires close collaboration with analog designers, CAD, process, package, reliability, and verification teams. You will be expected to own challenging layout problems, establish best practices, improve methodology and automation, mentor engineers, and drive projects from floor planning through physical verification and tape-out readiness. Responsibilities Layout Architecture & Execution Own floor planning and physical implementation for complex analog, power, and mixed-signal blocks, and contribute to full-chip layout planning. Collaborate with circuit designers to capture electrical, matching, isolation, current-density, thermal, reliability, and area requirements. Apply advanced layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, noise isolation, high-current routing, electromigration robustness, thermal behavior, and yield optimization. Drive routing, integration, and sign-off readiness for block-level and chip-level layouts. Physical Verification & Sign-off Own and review DRC, LVS, ERC, PEX, antenna, density, latch-up, and reliability verification as required by the process and product. Analyse extracted parasitics with designers and support post-layout simulation closure. Identify physical-design risks early and drive corrective actions with design, CAD, PDK, process, and package teams. Ensure layout databases, review records, and release documentation meet tape-out quality standards. Methodology, Automation & IP Reuse Develop and deploy automation using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar languages to improve quality and turnaround time. Drive layout methodology improvements, reusable templates, checklists, and portability of IP across products and process technologies. Work with corporate engineering and CAD teams to resolve tool, PDK, extraction, and process-flow issues. Evaluate new layout tools and techniques and lead practical adoption within the team. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Lead layout reviews and provide clear estimates, progress updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans. Mentor junior and mid-level layout engineers and raise the technical standard of the broader team. Influence project planning, task allocation, technical decisions, and hiring through demonstrated technical depth. Operate independently on ambiguous and complex assignments, escalating issues with clear options and recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 10+ years of relevant experience in analog, power, or mixed-signal IC layout and associated development flows. Demonstrated ownership of complex block-level layout and meaningful contribution to full-chip integration and tape-out. Deep understanding of matching, parasitic control, noise isolation, guard rings, latch-up prevention, high-current routing, electromigration, IR drop, thermal effects, and reliability-aware layout. Hands-on expertise with Cadence Virtuoso and physical verification tools such as Calibre, PVS, or equivalent. Experience with extraction and reliability tools is expected. Experience working with deep-submicron CMOS and preferably BCD or high-voltage process technologies. Ability to automate layout or verification tasks using SKILL, TCL, Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages. Proven ability to lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and drive layout methodology improvements. Strong cross-functional communication skills in a multisite and multicultural environment. Results-oriented, self-driven, and able to deliver high-quality work under tight schedules with limited supervision.

 About the Role We are looking for a proactive and organized service coordinator to support our branch service operations. The role will involve coordinating with service engineers, customers, the area service manager, the head office, finance, stores, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of service-related activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong follow-up ability, basic MS Office knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple administrative and service-coordination activities effectively. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Service & Payment Coordination 
 Follow up on outstanding service payments across AMC, Trading, Repair, Upgradation, and other service-related activities , including advance, due, and balance payments. Follow up on payments against both tax invoices and proforma invoices. Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure timely collection and closure of outstanding payments. Maintain proper records and follow-up trackers for pending payments. 
 2. Service Reporting & Documentation 
 Prepare and submit weekly service analysis reports to the Area Service Manager and Head Office. Maintain and share reports related to monthly revenue, expenditure, and collection . Ensure timely submission of service-related documents, including:
 Service Reports Installation Reports Customer Feedback Forms Vouchers Other relevant service documents Coordinate with service engineers to ensure proper documentation and timely submission. 
 3. Service Call & ERP Coordination 
 Monitor and maintain service call records in the IERP system , including:
 Call logging Call closing Service report uploading Status updates Follow up with service engineers for timely closure and documentation of service calls. Maintain the monthly complaint log of service engineers and submit the required report to HR. 
 4. Customer Coordination 
 Handle customer queries and service-related inquiries through telephone and email . Coordinate with customers and concerned service engineers for timely resolution of queries. Maintain professional communication and ensure timely follow-up on customer requirements. Coordinate for acknowledgement of spare parts/materials delivered through service engineers. 
 5. Spares & Gate Entry Coordination 
 Ensure that all spares/materials delivered through Service Engineers are properly acknowledged by the customer. Coordinate and collect required documentation such as delivery reports and gate entry details . Ensure proper records are maintained and submitted to the concerned department/head office. 
 6. Branch Administration 
 Maintain branch office attendance records and submit weekly attendance reports to Head Office. Coordinate routine administrative activities of the branch office. Coordinate housekeeping activities and ensure cleanliness and proper upkeep of the office/store area. Handle submission and coordination of various office utility bills and administrative documents with the Head Office. Maintain required attendance and administrative records of in-house staff. 
 7. Petty Cash & Courier Management 
 Handle branch-level petty cash and maintain proper records, supporting documents, and vouchers. Coordinate all incoming and outgoing courier activities. Maintain courier records and ensure timely dispatch and receipt of documents/materials. 
 8. Call Handling & Communication 
 Attend incoming and outgoing calls professionally. Direct calls to the concerned person, department, or extension. Maintain required call/communication records. Coordinate internal and external communication as required for smooth branch operations. 
 9. Inventory & Stock Coordination 
 Maintain proper stock records for the branch/store. Monitor stock movement and ensure records are updated regularly. Coordinate with the Stores Department regarding stock availability, movement, and requirements. Ensure proper documentation of material movement. Required Skills & Competencies 12 years of experience in service coordination / back office / branch administration / customer coordination / service operations. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication . Ability to maintain reports, trackers, and documentation accurately. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Customer-oriented approach with professional communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with Service Engineers and internal departments. Basic understanding of invoices, payments, and collection follow-up will be an advantage. Candidates from service-oriented, engineering, equipment, manufacturing, or technical organizations will be preferred. 
 Key Deliverables 
 Timely collection/payment follow-up. Accurate and timely weekly/monthly reporting. Proper service documentation and ERP updates. Effective coordination with Service Engineers and customers. Accurate branch attendance, petty cash, courier and administrative records. Proper stock and spare-part documentation. Timely escalation and closure of customer/service-related issues.

title: Executive
description:
Job Description Quality Executive / QC Executive 
 Position: Quality Executive / QC Executive 
 Department: Quality 
 Location: Delhi Warehouse 
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Head Quality 
 Experience: 37 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / Graduate; Engineering or Quality-related qualification preferred 
 
 1. Job Purpose 
 The Quality Executive will be responsible for ensuring end-to-end quality control at the Delhi Warehouse. The role will primarily focus on Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), return product inspection and segregation, customer complaint investigation, reduction of product returns and bad inventory, and continuous quality improvement . The individual will act as the primary Quality representative at the warehouse and work closely with Warehouse, SCM, Sales, Customer Service, Factory, and Quality teams to ensure that only quality-approved products are dispatched to customers. 
 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 
 A. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) 
 Conduct 100% Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI) of sofas and mattresses before dispatch from the Delhi warehouse. Inspect products for: Appearance and finishing Dimensions and construction Stitching and upholstery Packing and packaging condition Labels and MRP Product specifications and details Other applicable quality parameters Ensure all products comply with defined company quality standards and SOPs before dispatch. Identify, hold, and segregate defective products before they reach customers. Maintain accurate PDI records and inspection status in Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel . Immediately escalate recurring or critical defects to the Quality and concerned functional teams. Ensure no product is dispatched without the required quality approval. 
 
 B. Return Product Inspection & Segregation 
 Inspect all returned mattresses, sofas, and accessories received at the Delhi warehouse. Assess the physical condition, defect, usage, and repairability of returned products. Categorize returned products as: Reworkable: Products that can be restored to saleable condition through approved rework. Non-Reworkable: Products that cannot be economically or technically restored and should be classified as bad inventory. Ensure proper physical segregation, tagging, and identification of reworkable and non-reworkable products. Maintain complete return inspection records, including: Return reason Defect type Product condition Root cause, wherever identifiable Rework requirement Final disposition Coordinate with relevant teams for timely rework, release, disposal, or closure of returned inventory. Monitor rework quality before products are released back to saleable inventory. 
 
 C. Customer Complaint Investigation & Market Visits 
 Visit customer locations, whenever required, to investigate quality-related complaints. Conduct on-site product inspection and identify the actual cause of the complaint. Distinguish between manufacturing defects, handling/storage damage, installation-related issues, usage-related concerns, and other causes. Prepare detailed inspection/visit reports supported by photographs, observations, findings, and recommendations. Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Warehouse, Factory, and Quality teams for appropriate resolution. Track repeated customer complaints and identify areas requiring corrective and preventive action. Provide timely technical inputs to support complaint closure. 
 
 D. Return & Bad Inventory Reduction 
 Take ownership of reducing overall warehouse returns and bad/non-reworkable inventory . Analyze return data and identify major product-, defect-, and reason-wise trends. Identify recurring issues and work with cross-functional teams to eliminate root causes. Monitor rework recovery and maximize conversion of reworkable returns into saleable inventory. Drive corrective actions to prevent repeat defects and avoid unnecessary returns. Monitor product-wise and defect-wise return trends. Prepare periodic reports covering: Return % Rework % Non-Reworkable % Bad Inventory Major defect categories Corrective action status 
 
 E. Warehouse Quality Control 
 Ensure compliance with company-defined quality standards, SOPs, and work instructions. Conduct regular quality checks on: Product handling Storage conditions Stacking FIFO practices Packing Loading and unloading Dispatch practices Identify potential quality risks within warehouse operations and initiate timely corrective action. Ensure proper handling of mattresses, sofas, and accessories to prevent transit or warehouse damage. Support internal and external quality audits. Participate in quality improvement and process improvement initiatives. 
 
 F. Data Management & MIS Reporting 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date quality records using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets . Maintain records related to: PDI inspections Product returns Reworkable / Non-Reworkable products Customer complaints Market visits Bad inventory Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) Product-wise trends Defect-wise trends Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly quality MIS reports. Analyze quality data and highlight key issues, trends, and improvement opportunities to management. Prepare presentations and quality reports using Microsoft PowerPoint . Maintain data accuracy, completeness, and timely reporting. Update relevant quality information in SAP , wherever applicable. 
 
 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Performance will be measured primarily through: Reduction in overall warehouse return % Reduction in bad/non-reworkable inventory 100% PDI compliance before dispatch Reduction in customer complaints Reduction in repeat customer complaints Improvement in rework recovery % Timely closure of returned products Accuracy and completeness of quality data Timely submission of daily/weekly/monthly MIS Effective implementation and closure of corrective and preventive actions Reduction in warehouse-related product damage Improvement in overall warehouse quality performance 
 
 4. Required Skills & Competencies 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Good knowledge of Quality Control / Quality Assurance activities. Experience in the mattress, sofa, furniture, upholstery, home-furnishing, or similar industry will be preferred. Good understanding of mattress and sofa construction, materials, upholstery, finishing, and common quality defects. Strong knowledge of: Inspection and defect identification Product segregation Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) Quality documentation Quality data analysis Good working knowledge of: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Google Sheets SAP Ability to prepare and analyze MIS reports and present quality trends to management. 
 
 Behavioural Competencies 
 Strong ownership and accountability. Excellent observation and attention to detail. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently at a warehouse location. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Effective cross-functional coordination. Willingness to travel for customer complaint investigations. Ability to handle difficult quality issues and drive timely closure. Strong focus on prevention rather than only defect detection . Result-oriented approach with a focus on reducing returns and bad inventory. 
 
 5. Qualification & Experience 
 Qualification: Diploma / Graduate in a relevant discipline. Diploma / Degree in Engineering, Quality, Production, Mechanical, or a related field will be preferred. Experience: 37 years of relevant experience in Quality Control / Quality Assurance. Experience in mattress, sofa, furniture, upholstery, home-furnishing, or related manufacturing/warehouse operations will be preferred. 
 
 6. Key Interfaces 
 The Quality Executive will work closely with: Warehouse Operations Supply Chain / SCM Sales Customer Service Factory / Manufacturing Quality Team Logistics / Dispatch Other relevant support functions 
 
 7. Overall Role Expectation 
 The Quality Executive will be the primary Quality representative at the Delhi Warehouse and will be responsible for end-to-end warehouse quality performance. The role is not limited to identifying defects. The individual is expected to: Prevent defective products from being dispatched. Ensure proper inspection and disposition of returned products. Maximize recovery of reworkable inventory. Minimize bad/non-reworkable inventory. Reduce customer complaints and repeat complaints. Identify and eliminate recurring quality issues. Drive corrective and preventive actions. Ensure accurate quality data and timely MIS reporting. Continuously improve the overall quality performance of the Delhi Warehouse.

**Job Description**
**About BetaNXT**
 BetaNXT is a leading provider of frictionless wealth management infrastructure, real\-time data solutions, and enhanced advisor experience. We invest in platforms, products, and partnerships to accelerate growth for the ecosystem we serve. Our connective approach empowers our clients to deliver comprehensive, end\-to\-end advisor and investor experience.
   

  

 BetaNXT is a premier provider of technology, data, and operations as services to a rich client base of wealth managers, institutional wealth firms, and digital brokers. It is comprised of three industry\-leading businesses which, combined, provide end\-to\-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.
   

  

**Overview Of The Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**
 The Enterprise IT Tools Support Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, usability, and operational effectiveness of enterprise technology platforms and business\-critical IT tools across the organization. This role provides technical support, system administration, user enablement, and application configuration services to ensure seamless business operations and high\-quality user experience.
   

  

 The role operates at the intersection of IT Operations, Enterprise Applications, User Support, and Business Process Enablement, delivering timely issue resolution, user access management, system customization, and data administration. The individual plays a hands\-on role in troubleshooting complex issues, supporting application enhancements and releases, facilitating data integration, and driving continuous improvement through stakeholder engagement, training, and process optimization.
   

  

**Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**
**Responsibilities**
* Provide first and second\-level support to enterprise users for software applications via phone, email, and chat.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues in a timely and efficient manner.
* Document and track all support requests, resolutions, and follow\-up actions in ServiceNow.
* Collaborate with the development team to escalate and resolve complex issues.
* Conduct user training sessions and create documentation to help users understand and effectively use Enterprise software.
* Assist in the testing of new software releases and updates to identify potential issues.
* Provide feedback to the development team on user experience and suggest improvements.
* Configuring/customizing commercial applications to meet business needs
* Support user account maintenance in software applications
* Facilitating Export or Import of data across multiple application platforms
* Create and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards using appropriate charts, visual layouts, filters, and drill\-down capabilities to present business and operational data clearly.
* Full Understanding of business workflows and processes
* Developing good working relationships with users across the organization


**Skills \& Experience Of The Enterprise Tools Support Engineer**
* 3\+ years of experience supporting enterprise IT tools, business applications, in a corporate environment
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience in a technical support role, preferably in software application support.
* Strong knowledge of software troubleshooting techniques and tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote support tools.
* Working knowledge of Power BI data visualisation, including dashboard design, chart selection, data storytelling, interactive reports, and translating business requirements into meaningful visual insights.
* On\-Call coverage may be required.


**Preferred Software/Tool Experience**
* CRM/CSM/ITSM/CMDB: ServiceNow, Salesforce
* PDLC/SDLC: JIRA, Confluence, Kiplot, Gitlab Ultimate, Testrail.
* Enterprise tools: PowerBI, M365 suite
* Knowledge of SQL, scripting languages, or other programming languages is a plus.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms is desirable.

description:
About the Client Our client is a leading global engineering and technology services organization specializing in product engineering, digital transformation, semiconductor engineering, embedded systems, and next-generation technology solutions. The organization works with leading global technology and product companies across industries such as automotive, semiconductor, communications, consumer electronics, industrial automation, and other high-technology domains. With strong capabilities across the semiconductor product development lifecycle, the organization supports customers in areas including ASIC/SoC design, analog and mixed-signal engineering, embedded systems, verification, physical design, silicon validation, and product engineering. 
 About the Role We are looking for a highly experienced Principal Analog Mixed Signal Engineer with 1218 years of relevant experience in Analog and Mixed Signal IC/ASIC/SoC development. The successful candidate will take ownership of Analog/Mixed Signal IP and subsystem development from architecture through silicon and production, including circuit design, verification, layout supervision, tape-out, silicon bring-up, characterization, and production support. This is a senior technical leadership position requiring a combination of: Deep hands-on Analog/Mixed Signal design expertise Strong understanding of semiconductor development methodologies Multiple successful silicon tape-outs End-to-end IP/SoC ownership Silicon validation and debugging experience Technical team leadership and mentoring Customer-facing communication Cross-functional collaboration The ideal candidate should be capable of making critical architectural and circuit-level decisions, driving technical reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and working directly with customers and internal engineering teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Leadership Own Analog/Mixed Signal IP and subsystem development from concept to production. Define system-level and block-level architecture for AMS solutions. Establish technical roadmaps, design methodologies, and development strategies. Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, and technical decision-making. Evaluate design trade-offs related to performance, power, area, reliability, and cost. Provide technical direction to Analog/Mixed Signal design engineers. Mentor and guide engineers across different experience levels. Establish and drive engineering best practices. Identify technical risks early and develop mitigation strategies. Drive continuous improvements in design quality, methodology, and productivity. Support project estimation, planning, technical reviews, and milestone tracking. 
 2. Analog & Mixed Signal Circuit Design The candidate should have strong hands-on experience designing and leading development of several Analog/Mixed Signal blocks, including: Clocking & Timing Circuits PLL DLL Oscillators Clock generation circuits Clock conditioning circuits Charge pumps Data Conversion ADC DAC Comparators References and bias circuits Power Management LDOs Bandgap references Power management circuits Bias generation Low-power analog circuits High-Speed & Interface Circuits High-speed interface analog blocks SerDes-related analog circuits PHY-related analog blocks MIPI / USB / PCIe / DDR PHY exposure Sensor & Monitoring Sensor interfaces Monitoring circuits Calibration circuits Detection and protection circuits The candidate should be comfortable working at both architecture and transistor/circuit levels, depending on project requirements. 
 3. End-to-End IP / SoC Product Ownership Take technical ownership across the complete Analog/Mixed Signal development lifecycle: Requirements Architecture Circuit Design Simulation Verification Layout Post-Layout Signoff Tape-out Silicon Bring-up Characterization Production Responsibilities include: Analyze customer/product requirements. Perform feasibility studies and technical risk assessments. Define system and circuit architecture. Select appropriate circuit topologies and design approaches. Drive transistor-level implementation and optimization. Review simulation results and design margins. Ensure compliance with performance specifications. Coordinate with layout engineers and physical design teams. Supervise layout implementation and conduct layout reviews. Review parasitic extraction results. Drive post-layout simulation and closure. Ensure AMS signoff readiness. Participate in tape-out reviews and tape-out activities. Support silicon bring-up and debugging. Correlate pre-silicon simulations with silicon measurements. Drive characterization and performance analysis. Support production ramp-up, qualification, and yield improvement. 
 4. Analog/Mixed Signal Verification & Signoff The candidate will be responsible for establishing and driving robust AMS verification strategies. Key responsibilities include: Define verification strategy and acceptance criteria. Develop appropriate simulation plans for Analog/Mixed Signal blocks. Review simulation coverage and corner coverage. Perform and review: PVT analysis Corner analysis Monte Carlo analysis Mismatch analysis Noise analysis Reliability analysis Post-layout simulations Analyze process, voltage, and temperature variations. Ensure adequate design margins. Identify performance degradation caused by process variation and parasitics. Drive design closure against specifications. Support final AMS signoff and tape-out readiness. 
 5. Physical Verification & Layout Strong understanding of Analog IC physical implementation and verification is expected. The candidate should be able to effectively review and guide: Analog layout Matching-sensitive layouts Common-centroid structures Guard-ring strategies Power and ground implementation Noise isolation DRC LVS ERC Parasitic extraction Post-layout simulation Layout-dependent effects The role requires the ability to work closely with layout and physical design teams to achieve required performance, area, matching, reliability, and manufacturability targets. 
 6. Silicon Bring-Up & Validation A strong silicon background is essential for this role. Responsibilities include: Lead or support first-silicon bring-up. Develop silicon validation and characterization strategies. Debug silicon issues at the circuit/IP/system level. Correlate silicon measurements against simulation results. Identify root causes of silicon performance gaps. Recommend circuit/design corrections. Support engineering change and redesign activities where required. Analyze characterization data. Support yield improvement initiatives. Participate in product qualification and production ramp-up. Candidates with a strong record of taking Analog/Mixed Signal IPs from design through successful silicon will be highly preferred. 
 7. Customer & Cross-Functional Interaction The role involves significant interaction with customers and internal engineering organizations. The candidate will: Participate in customer technical discussions. Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Present architecture and design approaches. Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, and project status. Participate in customer design reviews. Collaborate with: Digital Design RTL/Verification Physical Design Analog Layout Packaging DFT Test Engineering Product Engineering Silicon Validation Program/Project Management teams Resolve technical dependencies across engineering functions. title: Senior Engineer GET
description:
Job Summary The Senior Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tools, including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, and associated wear components. The role applies advanced engineering principles, virtual product development tools, performance simulation, wear modeling, and validation methodologies to deliver solutions that improve customer productivity, wear life, durability, manufacturability, and total owning and operating costs. Responsibilities Lead design and development of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tool (GET) components including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, shank protection systems and wear packages. Develop solutions that improve machine productivity, penetration performance, wear life, serviceability and customer value. Perform structural, fatigue, performance, and wear simulations to support design decisions and reduce physical validation cycles. Utilize Virtual Product Development (VPD) tools to predict stress, durability, material behavior, and wear characteristics under various customer applications. Develop and validate wear-performance models using field data, laboratory testing, and simulation results. Analyze system interactions between blade, cutting edge, moldboard and ripper systems to optimize performance and life-cycle cost. Evaluate alternative materials, heat treatments, casting, forging and wear technologies to improve product performance. Support prototype builds, laboratory testing, field validation and production implementation. Lead root-cause investigations for field issues using analytical, simulation and test data. Skills and Competencies Analytical Thinking AI Uses: Knowledge of analytical techniques, engineering tools, simulation methods, and AI-assisted technologies that promote effective problem solving; ability to identify root causes of design and performance issues and develop multiple solutions that optimize customer value, durability, manufacturability, and cost. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation. Technical Excellence Innovation: Knowledge of mining applications, Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems, wear technologies, and engineering methodologies; ability to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges while improving customer value, product performance, durability, and cost competitiveness. Computer-Aided Design Engineering: Knowledge of engineering tools (Creo, Teamcenter, ANSYS, DEM, Wear Simulation) and techniques of parametric design, simulation, and knowledge-based engineering; ability to design, analyze, simulate, validate, and optimize Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems throughout the product development lifecycle. Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production. Work Arrangement This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation Relocation is available for this position. Visa Sponsorship Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:
Job Summary At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to team: Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences. The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source. We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence. In this role, you will: Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services. Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences. Lead and collaborate on complex, cross-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade-offs to maximize strategic value. Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes. Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management. Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on-call strategies, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service-level indicators and objectives. Safely integrate and operate machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred. 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience. Proven track record of end-to-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope. Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services. Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain. Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data-driven trade-offs, and align cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality software at scale. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading a software engineering team within a large-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes. Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines. Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience. Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes. Experience with cloud-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms. Proven ability to build an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities. Accommodation requests Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request.

Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager – Quality with strong hands-on experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control within the automotive two-wheeler or EV industry . The role will be responsible for driving process quality, vehicle assembly quality, defect prevention, process audits, quality systems and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. Establish and monitor process quality standards, inspection criteria and control plans across manufacturing lines. Drive First Time Right (FTR), FPY, PPM, rejection, rework and defect reduction initiatives. Conduct regular process, product and layered process audits to identify quality gaps. Ensure adherence to SOPs, work instructions, control plans, inspection standards and process parameters . Monitor critical-to-quality characteristics and ensure effective poka-yoke / mistake-proofing implementation. Lead RCA and CAPA for internal, customer and field quality issues using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and other quality tools . Drive containment and corrective actions for repeat defects and line-quality issues . Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D, Supplier Quality and Service teams to resolve quality issues. Establish and monitor EOL testing and functional inspection for vehicle assembly. Ensure traceability of critical components and process parameters. Drive SPC, MSA, process capability (Cp/Cpk) and statistical quality improvement initiatives wherever applicable. Support new product development, pilot builds and process validation from a quality perspective. Review and improve PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, Inspection Standards and SOPs . Drive supplier-related quality issues in coordination with SQE/Supplier Quality teams. Lead quality improvement projects, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives . Prepare and review daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS and management dashboards. Develop and mentor the IPQC/Quality engineering team . Must-Have Experience 10–15 years of experience in Quality within the automotive / two-wheeler / EV manufacturing industry . Strong and demonstrated experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control . Experience in vehicle assembly quality is highly preferred. Strong exposure to process audits, product audits and line quality . Experience with RCA, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and problem-solving methodologies . Good knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA and APQP . Experience in monitoring FTR/FPY, rejection, rework, PPM and customer/field complaints . Exposure to EOL testing / functional testing of vehicles. Preferred Experience in electric two-wheelers / EV manufacturing . Experience in a fast-paced OEM/start-up manufacturing environment . Engineering degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Electrical / Electronics . Six Sigma / Quality certification will be an added advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile Two-wheeler OEM + 10–15 years Quality experience + strong IPQC ownership + Vehicle Assembly Quality + Process Audit + RCA/CAPA + PFMEA/Control Plan + EOL + team management.

Supports all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Supports the tracking and resolution of service issues. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience - High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Operations - Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example. - Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. - Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors. - Supervises and manages employees. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence. Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals - Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis. - Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work. - Supports handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others. - Assists with energy conservation efforts by monitoring compliance during property tours. Supporting Projects and Policies Related to Guest Experience and Safety - Supports implementation of the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process. - Supports regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintece. - Sends copy of MOD report to all departments on a daily basis. - Ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures. - Understands and can implement all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc - Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures. Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service - Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention. - Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed. - Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved. - Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills. - Sets a positive example for guest relations. - Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. - Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals. - Maintains high visibility in public areas during peak times. - Provides immediate assistance to guests as requested. - Interacts with customers on a regular basis throughout the property to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction. - Records guest issues in the guest response tracking system. - Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees. - Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement. Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities - Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills. - Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance. - Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills. Additional Responsibilities - Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person. - Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems. - Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner. - Maintains a strong working relationship with all departments to support property operations and goals and to expedite the resolution of any problems that may arise through the general operation of the property. - Communicates any variations to the established norms to the appropriate department in a timely manner. - Participates as needed in the investigation of employee and guest accidents. - Performs Front Desk duties in high demand times. title: Member of Technical Staff (TM)
description:
Linux Administrator Job Description - 
 Linux administrators are back-end IT specialists who install, configure, and maintain Linux operating systems in a variety of organizations. This role involves server-side operations and troubleshooting tasks that support business-critical and development activities. Linux administrators also configure user access and monitor system stability and security through deployment and everyday use.
This role requires extensive familiarity with Linux systems and servers and may involve a high level of risk assessment and user support. Because Linux is an open-source operating system, administrators also frequently communicate and collaborate with other developers to develop and implement system enhancements.

 Linux Administrator Duties and Responsibilities - 
 While the specific duties of a Linux administrator can vary based on their business and industry, the general responsibilities of this role are relatively consistent. Based on listings that we analyzed, these duties include
Install and Configure Linux Systems
A Linux administrator s main responsibility is to install and set up Linux systems and servers, often for organization-wide deployment. They develop servers and work with individual users to ensure that the system works reliably and quickly and answer questions related to setup and installation. In this role, Linux administrators also set up the architecture of the system, including back-end databases and scripts for specific applications and use cases.
Perform System Maintenance
Linux administrators also perform routine system maintenance and resolve server-side issues as they arise. This aspect of the role requires the Linux administrator to review error logs and reported errors and seek out solutions. Frequently, Linux administrators need to work directly with the system s source code to make necessary changes to ensure reliable performance and then deploy those changes throughout the system.
Monitor System Performance
In addition to maintaining Linux systems and servers, Linux administrators also monitor system performance to prevent slowdowns and crashes. They may examine daily traffic logs and reports or receive direct reports from end users. If the Linux administrator notices potential issues or recurring problems within the system, they develop and deploy solutions so that the system remains usable for all personnel.
Provide Technical Support and Guidance
Linux administrators provide technical support and guidance to users and other administrators. In many cases, the Linux administrator works closely with other developers to answer technical questions or resolve issues with server-side performance. They may also support users by assisting with installation and maintenance of Linux-based programs and help debug these applications so that they work with existing servers.
Maintain System Security
Finally, Linux administrators maintain system security by actively identifying faults and vulnerable areas within the system s architecture. This part of the job requires extensive knowledge of viruses and other sources of system vulnerability, and requires the Linux administrator to proactively develop protections, particularly when deploying system-wide changes that can open up new vulnerabilities.

Good understanding of foundry signoff requirements, PDKs, and semiconductor manufacturing rules. Experience in debugging and resolving complex signoff violations at block and full-chip levels. Familiarity with GDSII/OASIS databases, netlists, and tapeout processes. Proficiency in Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting. **Apprenticeship Description:**

* Prepares and follows up for collection on overdue accounts allocated to him / her.

* Regularly monitor repayment of accounts, analyse causes of delinquency, report concerns timely.
* Timely resolve customer disputes
* Implements repossession of the asset
* Is responsible for the integrity of collection data and customer logs, including visit reports, relating to allocated accounts in the collection.
* Maintains accuracy in uploading trails on all cases, within set timelines.
* Strictly adheres to compliance.
* Maintaining relationship with Collection Agencies and their executives, follow up and updates
* Update Payments in VFS System
* Role involves Collections follow up across all Buckets, Repossession

* Should be a fresh graduate, preferably BCom or BBA
* Should have knowledge on Microsoft Office tools usage


**Competencies And Skills**
* Strong willingness to learn and explore career opportunity in financial services industry.
* Strong communications skills.
* Knowledge of working in a process driven organisation.
* Should be able to converse fluently in English, Hindi \& Regional Language of said state is must and additional languages will be added advantage.


**References**
 Candidate should be willing to provide references, if necessary, and consent to a reference check with his / her existing College.
   

  

**Note**
* Apprenticeship is for a period of 1 year, post that certificate of completion will be provided and there is no guarantee of employment after completion of training as an apprentice.
* During the apprentice period fixed stipend of INR 16,500/\- per month will be provided.
* Insurance on Group Personal Accident \& Term Life as per company policy will be applicable
* Travel reimbursement as per company policy on actuals based on set limits
* Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further rounds of the selection process. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.


**Work Location\-** 
 Gurgaon
   

  

 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
   

  

**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
 We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
   

  

 Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
 **Volvo Group** 
 . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
   

  

 At

 , we are working together to shape the world we want to live in. As the captive finance arm of the Volvo Group, VFS provides financial services and solutions that meet the needs of our customers’ evolving business. Through our dedication to innovation, we support society in its adoption of sustainable transport and equipment solutions. VFS is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and serves Volvo Group customers and dealers in more than 50 markets.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 We offer a solid and competitive package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy a diverse working environment with a culture of care and inclusion. As an investment, we support your personal development and growth to achieve your career aspirations. Volvo Financial Services is an on\-site business and we understand that you might need occasional or temporary flexibility, which your leader is equipped to manage and fits well to our culture, as being together enables us to build upon our innovative and collaborative culture, as well as develop you for continued success.

Prepare and review daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS and management dashboards. Develop and mentor the IPQC/Quality engineering team . Ideal Candidate Profile Two-wheeler OEM + 10–15 years Quality experience + strong IPQC ownership + Vehicle Assembly Quality + Process Audit + RCA/CAPA + PFMEA/Control Plan + EOL + team management.

title: Senior Purchase Executive
description:
Senior Executive- Purchase Location- Dommasandra 
 Job Purpose To manage and execute the procurement of construction materials, consumables, equipment, and services required for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for vendor development, sourcing, negotiations, purchase order processing, cost optimization, and ensuring timely availability of materials at project sites while maintaining quality and commercial requirements. Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end procurement activities for assigned real estate and construction projects. Source and procure construction materials such as cement, steel, aggregates, blocks, tiles, sanitaryware, plumbing materials, electrical materials, hardware, paints, waterproofing materials, and other project requirements. Understand material requirements, specifications, BOQs, purchase requisitions, and project schedules. Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors. Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors and prepare comparative statements. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial terms with suppliers. Generate and process Purchase Orders in accordance with approved requirements and company policies. Coordinate with Project, Planning, QS, Stores, Finance, and Accounts teams to ensure timely procurement and delivery. Monitor purchase orders and follow up with vendors for timely delivery to project sites. Ensure materials are procured within approved budgets and commercial terms. Track material prices and market trends to identify cost-saving and value-engineering opportunities. Maintain an updated vendor database and evaluate vendor performance based on quality, cost, service, and delivery. Resolve issues related to material quality, quantity, delivery delays, billing, and vendor payments in coordination with relevant teams. Ensure procurement documentation, quotations, approvals, POs, invoices, and supporting records are properly maintained. Support rate contracts and annual procurement negotiations for frequently used materials. Coordinate with site teams to understand urgent and critical material requirements and ensure timely availability. Assist in developing alternate sources and suppliers to minimize procurement risks. Ensure compliance with organizational procurement policies, approval matrix, and commercial procedures. Prepare regular procurement reports covering purchase orders, pending deliveries, cost savings, vendor status, and material procurement. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of construction and real estate procurement . Good understanding of construction materials, specifications, and market rates. Strong vendor development and negotiation skills. Good commercial and analytical skills. Ability to evaluate quotations and prepare comparative statements. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and procurement/ERP systems. Ability to manage multiple project requirements simultaneously. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Cost-conscious and result-oriented approach. Ability to work under pressure and meet project timelines. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commerce, or a related discipline . A diploma/degree in Civil Engineering with relevant procurement experience will be preferred. Experience 47 years of relevant experience in Purchase/Procurement. Experience in real estate, construction, infrastructure, or contracting companies is preferred. Candidates with experience handling procurement for residential/commercial projects will be an added advantage.

Key Skills: purchase order processing,Vendor Negotiation,Sourcing,Vendor Development,Cost Optimization,Vendor,Processing,Process

description:
Division: Marble Base Location: Bangalore Travel Requirement: Hyderabad and other client sites, as required Job Summary The Senior Executive - Logistics will manage the safe and timely delivery and unloading of marble at client sites. The role requires close coordination with transporters, clients operations teams, site supervisors and internal departments to ensure smooth unloading with minimal or no damage. Role Overview The candidate will be based in Bangalore but must travel to Hyderabad whenever required. Depending on site requirements, the candidate may need to stay in Hyderabad for up to 15 consecutive days. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with transporters, drivers, clients and internal teams to ensure vehicles reach client sites on time. Remain present at the client site until the entire consignment is safely unloaded, inspected and formally handed over. Ensure marble slabs and products are handled and unloaded safely, with minimal or no damage. Coordinate the availability of labour, cranes, forklifts and other unloading equipment at the site. Build and maintain strong relationships with the client s operations team, site supervisors, contractors and security personnel. Address client queries related to delivery, material quantity, documentation, damage or shortages. Manage last-minute operational issues such as vehicle delays, unloading restrictions, labour shortages, equipment unavailability and site-access challenges. Verify the material quantity and condition against the dispatch documents. Immediately report any shortage, breakage or damage and coordinate with the relevant teams for resolution. Obtain proper acknowledgement and Proof of Delivery after successful unloading. Provide timely updates to the management regarding vehicle movement, unloading progress, client concerns and delivery completion. Travel to Hyderabad and other client sites whenever required. Stay at the client location for extended periods, including up to 15 consecutive days, if operational requirements demand. Documentation Responsibilities The candidate will be responsible for maintaining and completing the following documentation: Tax invoice Delivery challan E-way bill Lorry Receipt/Goods Receipt (LR/GR) Packing list Purchase Order or Work Order reference Vehicle and driver details Gate entry and vehicle-entry documents Material unloading checklist Quantity and condition verification report Damage, breakage or shortage report, wherever applicable Site photographs before, during and after unloading Client acknowledgement Proof of Delivery (POD) Material handover note Transporter bills and supporting documents Daily delivery and unloading status report Candidate Requirements Graduate or diploma holder in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations or a related field. Relevant experience in logistics, site coordination or transportation. Experience in marble, natural stone, building materials or other fragile/heavy products will be preferred. Strong understanding of delivery, unloading and transportation documentation. Excellent communication, coordination and relationship-management skills. Ability to manage client queries and resolve last-minute site-related challenges. Willingness to travel frequently and stay outside the base location for extended periods. Ability to work independently and remain at the site until the complete unloading and handover process is finished. Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of ownership and attention to detail.

title: Warehouse Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a proactive and experienced Warehouse Executive to lead the day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for warehouse operations, inventory management, order fulfillment, dispatch planning, logistics coordination, team leadership, and operational excellence while ensuring high service levels and inventory accuracy. 
 Key Responsibilities: Manage complete dark store operations and ensure smooth daily functioning. Ensure timely receiving, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch of customer orders. Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular stock reconciliation and cycle counts. Monitor stock availability and prevent stock-outs, overstocking, and inventory losses. Implement FIFO and FEFO practices to minimize expiry and product wastage. Ensure proper storage conditions for groceries, pulses, spices, and other food products. Monitor warehouse hygiene, pest control, cleanliness, and safety standards. Coordinate with procurement and suppliers for timely inward of inventory. Supervise order fulfillment to achieve defined turnaround time and accuracy targets. Manage dispatch planning and coordinate with third-party logistics partners. Oversee the operations of COWBERRY's dedicated delivery vehicle and driver. Optimize delivery routes to improve delivery efficiency and reduce operational costs. Lead, train, motivate, and monitor warehouse staff and delivery personnel. Prepare manpower schedules and ensure optimum workforce utilization. Monitor daily productivity and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency. Conduct regular stock audits and investigate inventory discrepancies. Ensure compliance with company SOPs, FSSAI regulations, and warehouse safety standards. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management. Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Finance, and Customer Support teams to ensure seamless operations. Control operational expenses while maintaining service quality. Resolve operational issues promptly to ensure uninterrupted business operations. 
 Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field. Certification in Warehouse Management or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage. 
 Experience: 25 years of experience in Dark Store Operations, Warehouse Management, Grocery Retail, FMCG, Supermarket Operations, E-commerce, or Quick Commerce. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Local resident with strong knowledge of city routes and delivery networks. Experience in FMCG, grocery retail, supermarket, or quick-commerce operations. Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage warehouse teams. Hands-on approach to operations and problem-solving. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
